messages:
maria.support: Customer (AcmeMaps) reporting huge latency and auth 401s since 09:42 UTC. They were pinned to us-west but ~60% of calls show region=eu-west. Token check passes in us-west but fails in eu due to key restrictions. Repro: send /v1/generate with key X in us-west region -> returns 200; rerun, backend routes to eu -> 401. Attaching logs snippet.

raj_cust: seeing 401s and double egress billed. Can reproduce intermittently.

maria.support: I grabbed logs, looks like failover policy's priority array was edited 2h ago via console by ops-team (commit id: c7f4). The JSON in console has 'priority': [ "eu-west", "us-west" ] (strings) instead of identifiers, might have made parser treat it as unordered leading to default fallback to first in alphabetic order -> eu-west.

tom.sre: @ingrid any chance recent router parse change treats numeric index vs string differently? I can see a spike in cross-region requests at 09:40.

ingrid.runtime: Looking. On it. Can you dump the policy blob for route /generate? Also what's the sticky session cookie TTL? If cookie missing, we fallback to policy order.

maria.support: policy blob:
```
{
  "failover": {
    "priority": ["eu-west","us-west"],
    "weights": null,
    "sticky": true,
    "sticky_ttl": 3600
  }
}
```

i've highlighted the original had weights: [50,50] but console commit had weights omitted. Customer used our 'reserved us-west' capacity; after node flapped we expected failover to us-west->eu, but it seems priority order flipped.

ingrid.runtime: repro steps I'm running: 1) create session with X-cookie on us-west. 2) force us-west to return 503 for healthcheck. 3) router should pick fallback per priority/weights. On my local sim the router sorted the priority array alphabetically during policy parse due to a refactor; that's the bug. The array was normalized to a set then iterated.

ingrid.runtime: proposed fix: preserve order on parse (treat as ordered list), and treat missing weights as equal weights if null. I'll push patch and hotfix route parser. Need ops to rollback policy edit and reapply with proper priority order for now.

ops-team: rolled back console edit to previous blob at 10:05 UTC. Confirming traffic shifting back to us-west. @maria.support can you ask customer to confirm latency/billing impact?

raj_cust: latency back to normal. 200 responses and no extra egress. Thanks. Will open a ticket for billing credit.

maria.support: assigning incident to eng-runtime. Raising severity to P1 for parser bug and billing impact. Will collect postmortem notes.

deploy-bot: deploy 2821 to prod/routers succeeded at 10:21 UTC (ingrid.runtime).

ingrid.runtime: deploy confirmed. Follow-up: adding telemetry to alert when region preference differs from session cookie region for >1% of requests in a minute.

maria.support: filing postmortem draft in #incidents. Thanks all.
